authority.prior_correction: Three hypotheses consumed and rejected; that closed ledger is not reset.
authority.termination: No third new economic mechanism, neighboring continuity window/weight/power, capacity/risk combination, or renamed variant in this continuation. Preserve every rejection. Correctness-only reconciliation and source recovery do not consume a new economic design.

root_evidence.finding: The fixed residual-opportunity account increased average exposure in all three pools but was rejected: union wealth 4.231186496672099 -> 3.7266846932076594, common-five 5.718046146255741 -> 5.601245688579341, removal 2.35820512290061 -> 2.7225212021031777 with removal drawdown 0.3302999756539289 -> 0.35195265698497846. Thus available resources and eligibility alone do not establish useful incremental opportunities. Actual per-symbol PnL differences show multimillion-yuan offsets inside the union book; these are accounting differences between full actual accounts, not attainable gains or additive counterfactual opportunities. Order count increased from 149 to 289 in union and 161 to 286 in removal. No failed treatment is carried into this new control.
root_evidence.scale_and_limit: The next mechanism must act on the composition and sequencing of the entire funded book, not claim to fill a large wealth gap through the roughly 2,801-yuan union fee difference. The observed union PnL changes include -1.608 million and -1.237 million in two holdings offset by +2.505 million in another; this establishes material capital-path sensitivity, not predictive skill. Improvement magnitude is unknown; only the registered full-account pair can measure it. No claim that the mechanism closes the original approximate common-five wealth shortfall.
root_evidence.direction_not_taken: A non-mutating reconstruction of the new recorded controls strictly matched all 2181 closes. Last-stop-source attribution found only 1/0/2 isolated stop exits following ATR-contraction-only tightening in union/common-five/removal. This does not support choosing stop-widening as the next main remedy. No alternative stops or counterfactual accounts were calculated.

external_basis.publication: Da, Gurun and Warachka (2014), Frog in the Pan: Continuous Information and Momentum, Review of Financial Studies 27(7), 2171-2218, DOI 10.1093/rfs/hhu003
external_basis.use: A directional hypothesis: gradual information arrival can differ from a few discrete jumps even at similar cumulative returns. This is not a replication of the paper, not evidence of A-share applicability, and not an economic acceptance claim. No paper return figures are used as quant thresholds.

hypothesis: Among the parent's already-qualified opportunities, incorporating the continuity of completed daily price changes can improve funding priority without adding exposure, changing eligibility, forcing swaps, or relaxing risk protection.
control: The complete unchanged observed_admission_completion owner, parameters and Config; no opportunity_allocation treatment and no rejected healthy-holding or admission filter.
treatment: Use one fixed causal priority: original positive momentum score multiplied by the fraction of positive daily returns, counting a zero return as half, over the existing Config.slow trading-session window. Include only adjacent sessions with fresh positive-volume quotes; missing quotes do not become zero-return observations. The denominator is the number of valid observed daily changes in that window. Use expanding in-sample history with min_periods=1 and neutral multiplier 1 only when there are no valid changes; do not add a pre-2023 warmup or new eligibility gate. Sort descending by this product, then original score, then symbol. Use that same ordering in the original allocation and fresh-order completion paths. A small neutral ordering hook may be added to the original components with exact control-path tests; it changes no existing numerical result. The signal is not multiplied into any risk limit, size formula or eligibility mask. All original name choices remain eligible; the policy is free not to fund them because original cash, slots, stop risk and concentration are scarce.
substantive_difference: The rejected residual-opportunity treatment changed capacity and exposure with the SAME ranking. This treatment retains the original two-position capacity and changes the information used to prioritize funding. It is not a nearby capacity/rank coefficient sweep. Prior funded-ownership experiments combined a 60-day regression-slope/R-squared rank with different entry, sizing, stops and lifecycle; their failures remain valid and do not prove or disprove this single information treatment on the corrected unchanged parent. No future-label diagnostic, identifier-specific score or tuned coefficient is introduced.
risk_tradeoffs: May prefer gradual but weaker trends, miss explosive leaders, worsen recovery, alter funded competition and indirect risk history, or fail in the removal pool. All adverse results must be retained. Do not hardcode losing stock IDs or replace whole-pool results with per-pool winners.
unchanged: original aggregate stop risk and concentration
nondecreasing stops and all outstanding protections
T+1, liquidity, costs and next-session execution
single production entry and no private reference source base
selection: Exactly six newly identified matched accounts: union, chatgpt_5, joint_optical_leader_removal, 2023-01-03 through 2025-12-31, initial cash 2000000, identical Config, data, runtime, cost and delay. Reuse decision_review.paired_screen unchanged: treatment wealth no lower and drawdown no higher in every scope, at least one strict improvement, existing tolerances. Reject without further diagnostics that select a variant. A screen pass only permits unchanged final coverage; it is not original economic acceptance.

exact unchanged control and original ordering hook
source/config/data/runtime identity and full raw account preservation
